title: Outlook: Share Availability
description: Easily share proposed meeting times directly from your calendar or while composing an email in Outlook. Select time slots and insert them into your message without manually typing dates and times. For one-on-one meetings, recipients can select an available time to book the meeting with one click. #newoutlook
